title: AI & Robotics
summary: Autonomous systems, neural architectures, embodied robotics, and physical AI computing.
brief: Design and develop innovative solutions that leverage artificial intelligence and robotics to solve real-world problems. Focus areas include autonomous navigation, computer vision, natural language processing, and human-robot interaction.

title: Space & Aerospace
summary: Satellite systems, orbital mechanics, aerospace engineering, and space exploration tech.
brief: Create solutions for space exploration and aerospace engineering challenges. Projects may involve satellite communication, orbital simulation, propulsion systems, or space debris tracking.

title: Quantum Computing
summary: Quantum algorithms, quantum simulation, error correction, and quantum-classical hybrid systems.
brief: Explore the frontiers of quantum computing by developing algorithms, simulations, or applications that leverage quantum mechanical principles for computational advantage.

title: Cybersecurity
summary: Threat detection, cryptographic protocols, network security, and privacy-preserving computation.
brief: Build tools and systems that enhance digital security. Focus on threat detection, vulnerability assessment, secure communication protocols, or privacy-preserving technologies.

title: Green Tech
summary: Renewable energy, carbon tracking, sustainable materials, and environmental monitoring.
brief: Develop technology solutions that address environmental challenges. Projects may focus on renewable energy optimization, carbon footprint tracking, waste management, or environmental monitoring systems.

title: Biotech & Health
summary: Medical diagnostics, drug discovery, genomics, and digital health platforms.
brief: Create innovative solutions at the intersection of biology and technology. Areas include medical diagnostics, telemedicine, drug discovery simulation, genomic analysis, and health monitoring systems.

title: Fintech & Web3
summary: Decentralised finance, blockchain protocols, digital payments, and financial inclusion.
brief: Build financial technology solutions leveraging blockchain, smart contracts, or traditional fintech approaches. Focus on financial inclusion, secure transactions, or decentralized applications.

title: Gaming & XR
summary: Immersive experiences, game engines, AR/VR applications, and interactive simulations.
brief: Design and develop immersive experiences using game engines, augmented reality, virtual reality, or mixed reality technologies. Applications may include educational simulations, training systems, or interactive entertainment.
